latest_release.name: Animate UI 2.4.3
latest_release.body:
## Fixes

- Navigation Menu: leaving it and coming back quickly no longer leaves a copy of the content over the one coming in. Back on the same item, its content stays as it was; onto another, the first one fades away. Base UI and Vue were affected.

**Full changelog**: https://animate-ui.com/docs/changelog

detail.readme:
Animate UI

Animated drop-in primitives for Radix UI, Base UI and React Aria, built with Motion. Swap the import, keep your shadcn/ui components.

![Animate UI](apps/v2/public/og-image.png) ## Getting started Animate every installed shadcn/ui component in one command: ```bash npx @animate-ui/cli@latest animate all ``` Or swap a primitive's import yourself: ```tsx // Before import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from 'radix-ui'; // After import { Accordion as AccordionPrimitive } from '@animate-ui/react/primitives/radix-ui'; ``` ## Documentation Visit [animate-ui.com](https://animate-ui.com/docs) to view the documentation. ## Contributing Visit our [contributing guide](https://github.com/imskyleen/animate-ui/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) to learn how to contribute. ## Code of Conduct This project follows a Code of Conduct to help create a welcoming community. Please read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) before contributing. ## License Licensed under the [MIT license with the Commons Clause](https://github.com/imskyleen/animate-ui/blob/main/LICENSE.md): use it in any application, website or product, commercial or not, but don't sell or redistribute the components themselves.
